radius_avp
       radius_avp command creates a RADIUS AVP object.

SYNOPSIS
DESCRIPTION
       radius_avp command creates a RADIUS AVP object, to be use with the radius_authenticate command.

RETURN VALUE
       Return the avp object.

VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT
